notes: Strip c: x 4160-5270, picks within ~3860-5570 (two picks slightly beyond: Duck Creek/Trimble 5598, Clough/Wabash 5623, both matching strip d). Centrelines fitted to the printed street lines (Hough-style line fits); streets here carry a solid water-pipe line along the middle, which was not taken as a street edge. Plate is turned ~30 deg. Names checked against today's OSM via a 4-point similarity fit (Montgomery/Duck Creek, Duck Creek/Stacey, Hudson, Trimble): residuals <20 px; matches Duck Creek Rd, Stacey Ave, Hudson Ave, Trimble Ave, Bevis Ave, Wabash Ave, Hewitt Ave, Evanston Ave, Malory Ct, Kinney Ave, Bonaparte Ave, Huron Ave, Pogue Ave, O'Bryon St, Lavinia Ave, Gold St, Paul St, Bedford Ter, Easthill Ave, Madison Rd. Clough Avenue = today's Crane Avenue. Edison Avenue and Section Avenue/Rural Avenue have no modern counterpart in OSM. Big lettering 'SOUTH HUDSON & CRANE AV. SUB.', 'HERBERT & PECHOUT'S 1ST/2ND', 'FOOTE'S SUBDIV'N', 'C.B. FOOTE'S', 'O'BRYON EST.', 'THE WALNUT HILLS ...' are subdivision titles, not streets. Coloured bands are subdivision lines. A ~40 px strip with 40"/51" sewers runs east from the end of Kinney (x 4045-4680, y ~5000-5040) along the north edge of Foote's land; not treated as a street.
